title: Commas in long str query param cause truncation and other weird behavior

answer.body:
if you are using Swagger then you are hitting the max url lenght limit of browsers and your issue do not depend from comma and space combinations.

Chrome and Firefox support URLs, up to 32,767 characters.

In firefox for example you get 400 bad requests.
